headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high flyers and modest guidance revisions.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved for most firms, driven by AI‑related deals. Several companies trimmed FY27 revenue guidance, while others raised margin targets. Overall sentiment remains positive but uneven.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue contributed significantly to profit jumps at HCLTech, Mphasis and Infosys, and underpinned large‑deal wins.

themes.title: Guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2%; HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% range; Wipro gave a flat‑range outlook for Q3.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.
Revenue grew 39.9% YoY, the strongest among peers.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY, the lowest in the cohort.
Net profit fell 1.9% YoY despite revenue growth.
